1491-6218-6723-8320.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

907-1479-8293.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-5434-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

225-2556-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-2556-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-2556-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Mnemonic Wall and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2762-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Thopter Squadron.
When Thopter Squadron dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

301-1453-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

57-3094-4846-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4846-7297.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5241-5282-7149.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Sakashima's Student dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Sakashima's Student enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Sakashima's Student leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima's Student from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

5170-5231-6132-6273.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

30-141-2438.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-2438.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-2438.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1640-4120.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, Pariah's Shield causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it's attached to.
Vigor will then prevent the damage and put that many +1/+1 counters on that creature instead.

129-3995-6723.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3995-6723.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

1003-5220-5330-6900.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1283-4331-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
1283-4331-6747.description:
Cast Chromatic Orrery by paying at most {3} due to Sami.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Chromatic Orrery from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-2921-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-4306-6281-6435.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
4067-4306-6281-6435.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Coati Scavenger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Coati Scavenger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Coati Scavenger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

228-3263-4853-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a Construct token.
The Construct dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Skullclamp and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

679-1149-2736.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Lich's Mastery to leave the battlefield.
679-1149-2736.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving an opponent control of Lich's Mastery.
If needed, activate Shadowspear by paying {1}, causing all permanents your opponents control to lose hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
Cause Lich's Mastery to leave the battlefield.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

3635-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Whirler Rogue.
Whirler Rogue enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-2842.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-2842.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2178-2274-4265.notablePrerequisites:
Royal Assassin does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Royal Assassin.
2178-2274-4265.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, it enters tapped due to Orb of Dreams.
Holding priority, activate Royal Assassin by tapping it, destroying the creature.
The creature dies, triggering Royal Assassin, untapping Royal Assassin.
Repeat.

900-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Feast and Famine attached to Najeela.
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Najeela.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
900-2011.description:
Declare Najeela as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Najeela.
Sword of Feast and Famine triggers, causing the defending player to discard a card and you to untap all lands you control.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

538-1183-2178-4061.notablePrerequisites:
Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dalakos.
538-1183-2178-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Dalakos triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
